wa_serenity_point_blasted.notes: New route (shared Oct 13, 2026); only Mountain Project lists it, the Exit 38 guidebook predates it. Bolt count not stated (permadraws only), so bolts/anchor stay null. Pitch count 1 is implied, not stated: not locked. Land manager not confirmed, access HELD. No DNR NAP/NRCA polygon covers this point (DNR layer 8 empty), so neither Mount Si nor Middle Fork Snoqualmie NRCA applies. The crag lies in the Mount Washington climbing area, which the Olallie State Park page says is reached from its Homestead Valley Trailhead, but at the crag point the USFS ownership layer reads NON-FS and the state public-lands layer returns no polygon, so it may be private inholding or park land missing from that layer. Owner decision or a State Parks boundary map is needed.
